verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official MCP server (mcp-v2) that Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Codex connect to via OAuth. Its tools fetch unaddressed PR review comments, drive auto-fix workflows, and view, search, and create coding patterns from the IDE. A probe confirms the official MCP server docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
